title: Design System: DrillFit iOS App (Field Manual target spec)

display.purpose: Screen titles, ceremony headlines, rank names. Uppercase commands only. Dynamic Type scaled.

headline.purpose: Section headers and card group titles. Uppercase.

title.purpose: Card headings, exercise names, list row leads. Uppercase.

body.purpose: Coach chat, descriptions, settings, notes. Sentence case, never uppercase.

label.purpose: Weights, reps, streaks, targets, timers, rank abbreviations. Mono, tabular figures, arm's-length legible.

shadows.name: ceremony-glow
shadows.value: drop-shadow in the rank tier color at ~45% alpha, brass bloom on CTAs
shadows.purpose: Earned moments only — PROMOTED overlays, rank-ups, streak milestones. Chrome itself casts no shadows.

motion.name: standard-transition
motion.purpose: Screen pushes and state changes. Quiet chrome — no bounce, no elastic.

motion.name: ceremony
motion.value: orchestrated entrance: insignia scale-in with tier-color glow, headline rise; ~600-900ms total
motion.purpose: Promotion and milestone overlays. Loud, theatrical, earned, skippable.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: MediaQuery.disableAnimations → crossfade or instant everywhere, including ceremonies
motion.purpose: Hard requirement on all new work; currently absent from the codebase (known gap).

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'Oswald', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-size: 1rem; background: #C8A24B; color: #1A1C1A; padding: 14px 24px; border-radius: 4px; border: none; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #A38443; }

narrative.overview: DrillFit should look like military field equipment, not like a fitness app. The design language extends drillfit.com's Field Manual aesthetic into a daily-use tool: near-black ink and field surfaces, bone text, brass as the primary accent, olive for secondary structure, alert red used sparingly. Weights, streaks, and targets read like instrument panels — monospace readouts on dark equipment panels. Rank insignia are first-class UI citizens, color-coded per tier. Texture cues from the manual — stamped labels, thin rules, mono eyebrows — are used with restraint: regulation equipment, not cosplay. Chrome is quiet; ceremonies are not. Ergonomics outrank theme: logging a set mid-workout stays fast, legible at arm's length, WCAG AA, and Dynamic-Type safe. This is the TARGET spec — the shipping app still wears an iOS-generic skin that new and reworked screens migrate away from.
keyCharacteristics: Ink/field dark equipment surfaces with bone text and one brass voice
Monospace instrument readouts for every number the user trains against
Condensed uppercase display type for headers, rank names, and commands
Rank insignia as color-coded, first-class UI citizens

rules.name: The Accent Swap Rule
rules.body: Theme packs survive as accent swaps inside Field Manual chrome: surfaces, text, type, and insignia are constant; a pack replaces brass with its accent and pressed variant. Brass is the default issue. The coin/Airborne economy is untouched.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Exactly one accent is live at a time. Rank colors belong to insignia and ceremonies; alert red belongs to consequences. No screen mixes accents.

rules.name: The Olive Floor Rule
rules.body: Olive never carries reading text. Secondary copy is Muted Bone (≥4.5:1 on ink); olive is for large labels and structure only.

rules.name: The Instrument Panel Rule
rules.body: Every number the user trains against — weight, reps, streak, target, timer — sets in mono, sized to be read at arm's length mid-set.

rules.name: The Bark Budget Rule
rules.body: Uppercase display type is for commands, designations, and ceremonies. Body copy and coach chat stay sentence-case — the sergeant shouts headlines, not paragraphs.

rules.name: The Quiet Chrome / Loud Ceremony Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces are flat and shadowless. Glow and spectacle are reserved for earned moments — PROMOTED, rank-up, streak milestone — and end when the moment does.

dos: Do build new screens to this spec and migrate reworked screens toward it; the iOS-generic look is the outgoing state, not a second theme.
Do set every trained-against number in mono at arm's-length sizes.
Do keep logging a set fast, one-handed, and ≥44pt per target — ergonomics outrank theme every time they conflict.
Do scale all type with Dynamic Type and ship a reduced-motion alternative with every animation — both are hard requirements on new work.
Do keep ceremonies loud and earned: rank-ups and streak milestones get spectacle; nothing else does.
Do keep theme packs as accent swaps only — surfaces, type, and insignia never change with a pack.
donts: Don't use Apple Fitness as a reference — no ring lineage, no vivid-accents-on-black system look.
Don't ship generic Material trackers, pastel wellness apps, or Inter-and-purple-gradient AI slop.
Don't use system blue (#0A84FF) as a brand color or default Apple grouped surfaces as chrome.
Don't show purchase affordances anywhere in rank progression UI — rank is sacred; Airborne never touches rank, coins, or streaks.
Don't let olive carry body text, or any text fall below 4.5:1 on its surface.
Don't play the military theme as cosplay — no camo textures, no gratuitous stamps. One stamp is a mark; five is a costume.
Don't celebrate the unearned — no confetti for opening the app, no praise for incomplete work.
